factCards.text: One Direction were put together during the 2010 series of The X Factor UK, after all five had already been eliminated as solo singers in the Boys category.
The group finished third in the 2010 final, behind winner Matt Cardle and runner-up Rebecca Ferguson.
factCards.sourceTitle: The X Factor (UK) series 7 final results, ITV

factCards.text: Simon Cowell signed the group to his Syco label after the series ended; their first single arrived the following year.
